chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ja'far, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
He said: 'It is upon men and women to proclaim the Takbir during the Days of Tashriq after the prayers, and this applies to one who prs alone and to one who prays voluntary prayers.'

key_terms.أَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ: The Days of Tashriq (11th-13th Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for Takbir during the Days of Tashriq in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* codifies the communal obligation of *Takbir al-Muqayyad* (restricted Takbir) during the Days of Tashriq, emphasizing its universality for both men and women regardless of whether they pray in congregation or individually. It highlights the continuity of ritual praise immediately following the obligatory prayers, reinforcing the festive and spiritual atmosphere of Eid al-Adha. This ruling is central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the public declaration of God's greatness during the Hajj season.
